rounds.text: Milky Mist Dairy Food Ltd demonstrates exceptional operational efficiency, generating a Return on Equity (ROE) of 32.22% that vastly outperforms the sector benchmark of 8.5% [E8]. This profitability is supported by a Return on Assets (ROA) of 5.86% against a sector benchmark of 3.65% [E7], while key valuation metrics like P/E, P/B, and EV/EBITDA sit at 0x compared to sector benchmarks of 18.72x, 1.86x, and 11.8x respectively [E5, E6, E10]. Reflecting this strong fundamental performance, the stock exhibits powerful momentum, sitting at 100% of its 52-week range [E4]. Conceded: the company trades at a high P/E of 122 [E1], offers a 0.00% dividend yield [E3], and a discounted cash flow analysis indicates a negative margin of safety of -197.1% [E31] with an intrinsic value of Rs 67 against a market price of Rs 200 [E30]. However, the company's superior returns on capital suggest that its growth potential justifies this premium, even if a reverse DCF implies a high earnings growth rate of 33.4% [E32, E40].
